info.title: PRAMAAN API
info.description: Decision-support API for AICTE application validation (SIH26261). All findings are advisory; the API cannot approve, reject or declare a document forged.

get.summary: Prometheus metrics protected by a separate token
List applications visible to the caller
Application workspace: checklist, documents, latest run

post.summary: Submit the application to AICTE for scrutiny
Sign in and receive a session cookie
Upload a document (multipart: file, doc_type). Replaces the current document of the same type.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Replays the first response for this user and application for 24 hours.

get.summary: Extracted claims with positions, verification attempts and integrity indicators
Rendered page image (PNG) for the evidence viewer

post.summary: Record an officer decision on a finding (reason required, audited)

get.summary: Active rule pack with clause references and version history

post.summary: Propose a new rule-pack version by changing numeric parameters
Activate a proposed version (must be a different administrator from the proposer)

get.summary: Recompute the hash chain and report the first broken event
Role-scoped counts computed from stored data
Latest synthetic benchmark report (produced by backend/eval/benchmark.py)
Readiness probe (database, rule pack, storage, OCR)
Enumerations and configuration the UI needs

post.summary: Set a password for a staff invitation
Change password and revoke other sessions
Decline a registration with a reason
Deactivate an account and revoke sessions

get.summary: Application activity visible to the caller

post.summary: Reply to a finding with optional supporting evidence
